title: Be Unto Your Name
lyrics_original: We are a moment, You are forever
Lord of the ages, God before time.
We are a vapor, You are eternal.
Lord everlasting, reigning on high.
Holy, Holy Lord God Almighty
Worthy is the Lamb who was slain.
Highest praises, honor, and glory
Be unto Your Name, be unto Your Name.
We are the broken, You are the Healer
Jesus Redeemer, mighty to save.
You are the love Song, we'll sing forever
Bowing before You, blessing Your Name.
Holy, Holy Lord God Almighty
Worthy is the Lamb who was slain.
Highest praises, honor, and glory
Be unto Your Name, be unto Your Name.
Holy, Holy Lord God Almighty
Worthy is the Lamb who was slain.
Highest praises, honor, and glory
Be unto Your Name, be unto Your Name.

bible_verses.english: Before the mountains were born, or ever you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”
saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God Almighty, You are eternal and holy, holding all of time in Your hands. Though my life feels like a passing vapor, I find peace knowing I am held in Your everlasting love. Thank You, Jesus, for being my Healer and the Redeemer who saves my soul. Receive my heart's highest praise, honor, and devotion today, for You alone are worthy of all glory.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God Almighty, You are eternal and holy, holding all of time in Your hands. devotional.reflection_english: Our lives are like brief moments in the span of eternity, yet the unchanging, eternal God knows us completely. When we feel frail, broken, or overwhelmed by time's swift passage, this song anchors our hearts in the One who reigns forever. Jesus does not view our weakness with distance; instead, He stepped into our human reality as our Healer and Redeemer. As we lift our voices, we are invited to surrender our fleeting cares and lay our highest praise at the feet of the worthy Lamb.
